purpose: Resolve applicable operational learnings before mutation and require explicit control coverage without converting EKB prose into declarative PASS.

applicability.prevention_rule_inheritance: After error codes are selected, load every active lf_prevention_rules row for those codes even when legacy rule phase/role metadata is null.
applicability.best_practice_inheritance: Supplement only by exact categoria of already-selected errors; best practices never create applicability by themselves.

resolution_invariants: Caller declares non-empty lifecycle_phases and consumer_roles; operation-name heuristics are forbidden.
Every explicit required code must resolve to exactly one active error row.
Every selected High/Critical/ALTA error must have inline prevencion or at least one active prevention rule.
Matched errors, prevention rules, best practices, phases, roles, operation and execution are fingerprinted together.
EKB resolution never means the preventive control was executed.
control_invariants: Every selected High/Critical/ALTA error and every explicit required code must have exactly one control binding.
DETERMINISTIC_CHECK and PROCESS_EVIDENCE require an execution receipt with executed=true and a passing outcome before mutation.
HUMAN_REVIEW requires an explicit reviewed PASS receipt before mutation; REVIEW_REQUIRED is not PASS.
A control_ref without execution evidence is coverage metadata only and produces CONTROLS_PENDING.
Unknown or duplicate control bindings block.
No PASS may be synthesized from detectability, prevention text, or validation text.

compatibility.input_governance_checkpoint: Reuse semantics of programacion.fn_input_governance_ekb_checkpoint without copying its hardcoded phase-code arrays.
compatibility.operation_contracts: Existing required_before_write EKB declarations remain consumer obligations; this capability supplies a common resolver/coverage receipt, not semantic ownership of each operation.
compatibility.legacy_rules: 121 active prevention rules with null phase/role remain reachable through selected error_codigo.

forbidden: treating EKB read as control execution
dropping legacy prevention rules because their own metadata is null
